scope:
Read-only residual census: prove source-origin-only body differences conservatively.

The origin mask only covers immediate stores in an actual file/length/line
record. It does not blanket-mask error constants or accept near byte similarity.
Other pairings require a real call edge from a body already matched under exact
normalization (or under this narrowly defined source-origin rule).
source_coordinate_rule: A relocated pointer is immediately stored to r10, followed in the same branch-free call-free block by exact field offsets+8 length and+16 line; the pointed ASCII slice must end in .rs. Only those identified store immediate bytes may differ.

limits: Source-origin-only is a statement about normalized body bytes and the typed record stores, not whole object/data/callee identity.
Actual call pairs are established from matched parent call offsets; different parent instantiations can supply several legitimate counterparts.
Nearest same-size candidates without call evidence are only search leads, not established source mappings.
A non-origin body difference does not establish a runtime behavior mismatch. Existing runtime evidence remains separate.
